Confirm that the submission contains no private data, credentials, predictor
binaries or licensed models. Scripts must not upload annotations. Describe any
scientific assumptions in HLA spelling and metric semantics. Maintainer
acceptance is repository hygiene, not scientific certification.

For new versions, omit legacy issue_url/ok/ng metadata fields. Create the
feedback Issue after acceptance, then update feedback.json in a separate PR.
Feedback-only PRs must leave every accepted converter file unchanged and label
counts with their observation timestamp (or explicitly leave it unknown).
Any GitHub user may submit. No scientific peer review or official algorithm
approval is required. Passing CI checks data hygiene; it does not execute or
scientifically validate a converter. Code/workflow changes need maintainer
security review before merge; community votes never bypass execution consent.
